| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Magnitude | Magnitude, Horizontal change (Gx), Vertical change (Gy) | The gradient magnitude in levels, or one signed component, shown as 128 plus half its value. |
| **Sharpness alpha** `alpha` | 1 | 0.1 to 5 | The alpha of the filter, how fast it decays. Our choice of 1. |
| **Omega** `omega` | 0.1 | 0.01 to 1 | The omega of the filter, the frequency of its sine. Our choice of 0.1, a small value, which brings the filter close to Deriche's limit x e^(-alpha |x|). |
